lq.ANSWER: The purpose of social projects in UHV is to help students develop a holistic perspective and experience social participation. These projects shift students from self-centred thinking to connectedness with family, society and nature. A socially relevant project should contribute to one or more dimensions of the human order: education-sanskar, health-sanyam, production-work, justice-suraksha and exchange-storage. Such projects also connect with the human goals: right understanding in every human being, prosperity in every family, fearlessness or trust in society, and co-existence with nature. Through social projects, students can observe real examples, collect and understand relevant data, and see how a wholesome way of living can support a humane society. Therefore, social projects are not only academic activities; they are steps toward understanding and participating in universal human order.
lq.QUESTION_DESC: What is the purpose of social projects in UHV?
